pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. Which response best shows understanding of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an.
   C. Say Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Use Prayers on special occasions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Prayers on special occasions has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Care for widows? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for widows.
   B. Use Care for widows to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Care for widows has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected verses Surah al- Furqan has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses Surah al- Furqan.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Selected verses Surah al- Furqan to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Types of verses? (1 mark)
   A. Say Types of verses has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Types of verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of verses.
   D. Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Funeral Rites? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Funeral Rites to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Funeral Rites has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Funeral Rites.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Asbabu al- nuzuul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Asbabu al- nuzuul has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Asbabu al- nuzuul.
   D. Use Asbabu al- nuzuul to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Say Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Governance in Islam Leadership in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Labour Relations in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Ethics of Da’wa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Foods and Drinks [Carrion Blood Pork animals dedicated to other than Allah ] and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. A — Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. D — Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. A — Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. B — Apply the teaching of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Governance in Islam Leadership in Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Labour Relations in Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Ethics of Da’wa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Foods and Drinks [Carrion Blood Pork animals dedicated to other than Allah ]; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
